Black Myth: Zhong Kui – 15 Minutes Gameplay Trailer
Today, Game Science unveils a brand-new 15-minute gameplay trailer for Black Myth: Zhong Kui, the second title in the Black Myth series. The trailer offers a first look at the protagonist in combat, along with a glimpse of the story.

As the game is still in early development, all footage was captured in-game from a work-in-progress build running at a 21:9 aspect ratio. The final release may differ.

RuneScape: Dragonwilds is coming to XBOX Game Pass | 15 September
RuneScape: Dragonwilds will be available day one with XBOX Game Pass on September 15. 

On RuneScape's forgotten continent of Ashenfall, dragons have awoken. Gather, build, skill and craft in this co-operative survival adventure. Only by mastering survival and uncovering ancient secrets can you hope to face the ferocious Dragon Queen.

RuneScape: Dragonwilds, the breakout open-world survival crafting game from Jagex: The RuneScape Company is coming to XBOX Series X|S. The release marks the first time in the RuneScape franchise’s 25-year history that a RuneScape title has launched on console!
